# labels

```go
import "katenary.io/internal/generator/labels"
```

Package labels provides functionality to parse and manipulate labels.

## Constants

<a name="KatenaryAnnotationPrefix"></a>KatenaryAnnotationPrefix is the stable prefix used for annotations added to the generated Kubernetes objects. Annotations are internal metadata, not user configuration, so they are not versioned.

```go
const KatenaryAnnotationPrefix = "katenary.io"
```

<a name="KatenaryLabelPrefix"></a>KatenaryLabelPrefix is the prefix used by labels read from compose files and katenary files. It is versioned so that a configuration written for an older Katenary version is never silently reinterpreted.

```go
const KatenaryLabelPrefix = "katenary.v4"
```

## Variables

<a name="LegacyLabelPrefixes"></a>LegacyLabelPrefixes lists the label prefixes used by previous versions.

```go
var LegacyLabelPrefixes = []string{
    "katenary.io/",
    "katenary.v1/",
    "katenary.v2/",
    "katenary.v3/",
}
```


IsLegacyLabel reports whether the given label key uses a prefix from an older Katenary version.

<a name="LegacyLabelsError"></a>
## func LegacyLabelsError

```go
func LegacyLabelsError(projectName string, badLabels []string) error
```

LegacyLabelsError returns the blocking error shown when a project still uses labels from a previous Katenary version. badLabels is a list of human readable lines such as "\- web: katenary.v3/ports \-\> katenary.v4/ports".

<a name="Help"></a>
## type Help

Help is the documentation of a label.

```go
type Help struct {
    Short   string `yaml:"short"`
    Long    string `yaml:"long"`
    Example string `yaml:"example"`
    Type    string `yaml:"type"`
}
```

<a name="Label"></a>
## type Label

Label is a katenary label to find in compose files.

```go
type Label = string
```

<a name="LabelMainApp"></a>Known labels.

```go

    LabelMainApp        Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/main-app"
    LabelValues         Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/values"
    LabelSecrets        Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/secrets"
    LabelPorts          Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/ports"
    LabelIngress        Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/ingress"
    LabelMapEnv         Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/map-env"
    LabelHealthCheck    Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/health-check"
    LabelSamePod        Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/same-pod"
    LabelDescription    Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/description"
    LabelIgnore         Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/ignore"
    LabelDependencies   Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/dependencies"
    LabelConfigMapFiles Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/configmap-files"
    LabelCronJob        Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/cronjob"
    LabelEnvFrom        Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/env-from"
    LabelExchangeVolume Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/exchange-volumes"
    LabelValuesFrom     Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/values-from"
    LabelDependsOn      Label = KatenaryLabelPrefix + "/depends-on"
```

<a name="LegacyLabelSuggestion"></a>
### func LegacyLabelSuggestion

```go
func LegacyLabelSuggestion(legacy string) Label
```

LegacyLabelSuggestion returns the v4 label that should replace a legacy one. Only the prefix is rewritten: some labels were renamed between v1/v2 and v3, the migration guide lists the matching names.
